translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with Phase 1.

'WISMO' (Where Is My Order) has no Spanish acronym; rendered throughout as the natural-language phrase '¿dónde está mi pedido?' (in quotes). Meta/OG use the same. FLAG: reviewer may prefer to keep 'WISMO' once with a gloss for SEO.

'cart' -> 'carrito'; 'abandoned cart' -> 'carrito abandonado'. 'ticket' kept (support ticket, widely used). 'DTC' kept (direct-to-consumer, standard in the trade). '3PL' glossed as 'operador logístico (3PL)' first use, then 'operador logístico'.
'AOV' (average order value) -> 'ticket medio' (standard ES ecommerce term).

Prices/figures unchanged, currency named: '$11k' kept as-is in stat chips (compact display) but glossed as '11.000 dólares' in prose/FAQ; '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; '$50 to $300' -> '50 a 300 dólares'.
Brand names (Shopify, Klaviyo, WhatsApp Business, n8n, Make, Zapier, Stripe, Slack) unchanged.
Blog 'related reading' links point to English blog posts (Phase 3 not started); anchor text translated. Nav/footer service + industry links point to /es.
